items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Tommy Benford and his brother Bill Benford was the bass player.

ctx.x: Well, that was a funny type of job, because we were playing and from time to time different people became the leader. When I went there it was Charlie Skeets. Charlie Skeets was a piano player from Brooklyn, and he had a very good band sometime before that, because I'd heard them from Brooklyn, he had all Brooklyn fellows in there. A couple of them played with Claude Hopkins later on. But he had the band and he left and Tommy Benford was the drummer in the band. Tommy Benford and his brother Bill Benford was the…
